capabilities: Render Mermaid diagrams inline in notes
Apply theme-matched styles and reusable presets
Export diagrams as SVG or PNG
Convert Flowchart and Agentflow diagrams to Canvases
extras: Desktop only; uses the bundled Pele renderer, so some diagrams may look different from standard Mermaid output.
intentEvidence: Edit a Mermaid diagram and see it update in the same Obsidian note.
problem: Editing Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian lacks live feedback, reusable styling, and direct export to common formats.
summary: Mermaid diagram editor that renders inline, applies reusable styles and presets, and exports SVG, PNG, or Canvas.
